telegram_sign_in_footer: API credentials and the sign-in are stored encrypted on the hub, and only api_id is shown. Both are deleted when you sign out.
switch_footer_bot_on: Turning it off stops {name}. You stay signed in.
switch_footer_bot_off: Turn it on to sign in.
switch_footer_on: Turning it off stops reading {name}. You stay signed in, and data already saved is kept.
switch_footer_off: Turn it on to sign in. Then {reads} will be saved to Knowledge and the Inbox, and the assistant can search it too.
sign_in_footer: The sign-in is stored encrypted on the hub and deleted when you sign out.
logout_remote: The API credentials and sign-in saved on the hub will be deleted, and this device's session on {name} will end too. You'll need to sign in again to use it.
logout: The credentials and sign-in saved on the hub will be deleted, and you'll need to sign in again to use it. Access granted in the service itself isn't revoked automatically, so revoke it there if needed.
feeds_archive_on: Saved to Knowledge: {name} content goes into the knowledge base, where the assistant and your AI twin can search it. Turn it off to stop saving new content; what's saved stays.
feeds_archive_off: Not saved to Knowledge: new content isn't saved. The Inbox and assistant still read {name} as usual.
feeds_inbox_off: Not in the Inbox: nothing new comes in; existing items stay.
deleted_with_inbox: Deleted. Knowledge chats: {chats}, people: {people}. Inbox items: {inbox}.
gh_too_old: personad is too old to read the gh sign-in
scope_advice_device: The device code sign-in is missing the {scopes} scope. Switch to another sign-in method, then sign in with a device code again.
scope_advice_gh: gh on {machine} is missing the {scopes} scope. Run {command} on that computer, or sign in with a device code instead.
ci_off: CI failures don't go to the Inbox.
ci_default_branch: Only CI failures on the default branch go to the Inbox, as Needs you.
ci_all: CI failures on any branch count as Needs you.
ci_mine: CI failures on the default branch and your open PRs count as Needs you; other branches are FYI.
inbox_footer: {ci} Failures on the same branch become one item, reruns included. It's marked done once a later run passes, the branch is deleted, or the PR is merged. Automated branches ({auto}) aren't flagged. @mentions, review requests and change requests from people count as Needs you; ones from bots are FYI. Muted repositories send nothing to the Inbox, and their existing items are marked done.
imessage_ai_on: People in your contacts and chats you have replied to go to the knowledge base and the inbox (sorted like Lark), and the assistant can search and summarize them; verification codes are masked. Turning it off stops at once; to delete what the hub kept, turn it off first.
imessage_ai_off: Not handed to Persona now: nothing syncs, nothing goes to the inbox, and the assistant can't read it. What the hub kept before is still there and can be deleted.
